diameterInterpretation: Twice the volume-equivalent radius computed from the archived mesh; this describes the model, not a newly measured physical mean diameter.
limitations: The 1994 equatorial radar geometry leaves north–south ambiguity: local feature latitudes and thickness are model-dependent. This view retains the archived 1999 radar model; the reference radius is derived from this mesh volume and is not an independently measured physical mean radius. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
radiusInterpretation: Volume-equivalent radius computed from the unmodified JPL archive mesh. The source paper gives a model-volume upper bound; no catalog diameter is imposed on the vertices.
